notes.title: v1.4.2 - New Trinkets and Fixes!
notes.content: [p]Hello Super Raft Boat Together players, this is main Shattered Journal Games dev, Margoon. This is the first update in almost a year! During that time, SJG has been working on many different games. One was announced that you can wishlist, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390730/Unidentified_Feline_Obliterators/"]Unidentified Feline Obliterators[/url]. Some other new games will be revealed soon![/p][p][/p][p]While there are currently no plans for more content updates, I did want to make v1.4.2 to fix some major bugs, and add some new trinkets! If there's any new big bugs from this update, they'll be fixed as soon as possible. Right now I want to focus a bit more on my new projects, so please look forward to playing them![/p][p][/p][p]Also SRBT is 65% during the Summer Sale, so now's the perfect time to start rafting![/p][p][/p][h1]New Trinkets[/h1][p] [/p][h2]KAP Drone[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/c92ed413f48274558dd97dd1961695272ee1a3d0.png"][/img][/p][p]Spawns a drone that attacks nearby enemies.[/p][p][/p][h2]Life Vest[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/b5c8e6961d622e1ca1845b9b140e1f94ea420e1b.png"][/img][/p][p]Saves you from death, and gets destroyed on use.[/p][p][/p][h2]Lag Light[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/b973edbc122e05ae8407b6b6051e84e36ae6871f.png"][/img][/p][p]Project light that slows enemies touching it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Trailmix[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/106c15f7e3b04a07aa2370420bd201c3ba085255.png"][/img][/p][p]Killing an enemy gives your next shot bonus damage.[/p][p][/p][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][p] [/p][h3]New Trinkets[/h3][list][*][p]KAP Drone[/p][/*][*][p]Life Vest[/p][/*][*][p]Lag Light[/p][/*][*][p]Trailmix[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Improved garbage collection (game shouldn't stutter every 2 seconds anymore).[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard/mouse player will only join as an extra local player by pressing specific buttons, not any button (Space, Escape, Enter, Z). Fixes problem where a controller player can't remove the keyboard when they want to play online.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed calibrate button in keybindings menu not being selectable by controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller not being able to swap characters in punch card menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Random trinkets that cost coins are now cheaper than buying a non-random trinket (same as for dollars).[/p][/*][*][p]Added offscreen indicators to many bosses that didn't have them.[/p][/*][*][p]If there’s multiple rewards for coins/bottles, it merges them into one unlock popup, and always happens after content.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed gun looking right for a frame when changing fast between command states.[/p][/*][*][p]Various network improvements.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Unity splash screen added (we no longer have pro).[/p][/*][*][p]All other splash screens are skippable and slightly shorter.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain M song will play for Freezer.[/p][/*][*][p]Raft magnet radius slightly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Freezer/Electric Freezer now descends from the top.[/p][/*][*][p]Added right joystick scrolling to all scroll menus that don’t have them.[/p][/*][*][p]When players die in water, their sprite is disabled instead of laying on water, and there's a sploosh effect and sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed out all keyboard/controller icons, and made controller prompts slightly bigger to make controls pop more.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.4.0 - The Froggy Fridge Update
notes.content:
Hello Super Raft Boat Together players, and welcome to SRBT v1.4.0! Patch notes are listed at the bottom, but here's some other cool info!

[h2] SUPER CRYPT BOAT BUNDLE [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42978/SUPER_CRYPT_BOAT/

Get both [i]Super Raft Boat Together[/i] AND [i]Crypt of the Necrodancer[/i] in this limited time bundle that will be available until July 15th. Two epic games, for such a great deal! Speaking of deals...

[h2] SUMMER SALE [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/fe18f79b8c43dcba512c66c1d8e8b2685bf77897.png[/img]
The summer sale has begun, and Super Raft Boat Together is 33% off! And with the bundles with Crypt and [i]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/i], there's no better time to get this game and some other great ones during the sale.

[h2]THE DEMO RETURNS[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955340/Super_Raft_Boat_Together/

The Super Raft Boat Together demo is back! It's been super polished and will allow people try out the game before deciding to buy it. There's many things that are not available in the demo, the biggest being that there's only 3 areas (Clear Skies, Rough Waters, and Sea of the Damned), and after that is an endless kraken swarm. This gameplay loop makes it similar to Super Raft Boat Classic, but without the ability to loop.

[h2]FROGGY SWAMP[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/4879b985c1d5bfb13d48c430564a83c97af8b7b2.gif[/img]

Sea of the Damned now has an alternate biome, players can now travel to the Froggy Swamp! Here there are frogs, flies, turtles, and even a new boss, the Crocodile! This area now brings the total biome count to 9! 

[h2]FREEZER[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/453ae550b285d2ef89c1a8c77dfdf220064ae239.gif[/img]

The Freezer has arrived and is now the main boss of Arctic Ocean! He also has another form, Electric Freezer, who appears in Electric Flow. Freezer can shoot regular bullets, and ice cube bullets that slows players and freezes rafts. His electric form also shoots electricity bullets that stun players. Are you tough enough to face this frozen menace??

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Biome: Froggy Swamp[/h3]
[list]
[*] Big Fly
[*] Small Fly
[*] Toad
[*] Frog
[*] Mushroom (Rock)
[*] Lump Head
[*] Pink Lump Head
[*] Turtle
[/list]

[h3]New Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crocodile
[*] Freezer
[*] Electric Freezer 
[/list]

[h3]Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pantano de Sapo song added: plays during Froggy Swamp.
[*] Riptide song added: plays when fighting against Dolphin and Otter.
[*] Terrain-M song added: plays against Cooler and Freezer.
[*] Windbound - Alternate hub song that only starts playing after completing the Kraken Statue (always plays after the Kraken Statue completion cutscene).
[*] Hub songs now have a small moment of silence between each other before going into the next one. 
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Electric Flow / Soda Sea / Vegetable Stew now all share the 4th biome slot, and that leads into Blood Sea.
[*] Chests, bottles, sailors, egg animals, and rescue barrels can now magnetize in water to players close enough. No more lost loot!
[*] Increased magnetization values for big and epic money bags.
[*] Compass bird's biome icons are visible without being in interactable distance.
[*] Cooler's strong soda bottles have blue warnings instead of red.
[*] In single player local UI, the build bar hammer icon pulsates when you have max rafts.
[*] Build bar in UI and on cursor is now brown instead of blue. Changes to different shade of brown when full.
[*] Increased time it takes for emote spawm warning to occur.
[*] Tutorial building sections are faster.
[*] Emote used count is added to full results screen.
[*] Soda Sea and Vegetable Stew must now be unlocked to be accessed.
[*] Players must now return to Raftport when beating the Kraken before completing the Kraken Statue.
[*] There's now small cutscenes for beating the Kraken the 2nd, 3rd, and beating the Super Kraken. (Previously there was only a cutscene for the 1st and 4th time).
[*] Fmod splash screen now also has Snoozeworks Logo, and a new background design. 
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dolphin will instantly submerge if it destroys enough rafts from a dash (can destroy more per phase).
[*] After looping, Dolphin will mix in spiky rocks during it's shoot attack. These destroy rafts.
[*] Narhwal knocks up players when it rises and destroys all rafts (including bumper rafts) while rising.
[*] Eels and Otter now destroy bumper rafts.
[*] Fish have been optimized more and should behave better when playing online.
[*] Small Krakens positions are clamped to stay a bit closer to the raft grid.
[*] Small Krakens will now shoot 2 shots in a row at Loop 1, and 3 shots in a row at Loop 2 and beyond.
[*] Small Krakens can now shoot ink missiles.
[*] Cooler drops slightly more money.
[*] Super Kraken has laser barrage and missile barrage. These have been mixed in with other moves during later phases and loops.
[*] Super Kraken now has different moves it uses when fighting it on Loop 1 and Loop 2/Post Loop 2.
[*] Super Kraken's idle and transition times are faster on Loop 1 and Loop 2/Post Loop 2.
[*] Post Loop 1, Super Kraken will aim the big laser at the closest player (angle is clamped so it won't shoot above it's own head).
[*] Super Kraken will not use big laser twice in a row.
[*] Froggy Swamp enemies can appear as loop enemies.
[*] Enemies cannot be damaged during cutscenes. 
[/list]

[h3]Controller Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Right shoulder is now also command swap instead of doing nothing.
[*] B is the center Emote, and the D-Pad directions are the other 4 emotes.
[*] D-Pad also now works in the UI navigation.
[*] Y is now trinket screen in game, and quick ready in Raftport.
[*] Fixed bugs where keyboard and controller can control the same character.
[*] Fixed bugs where one controller controls multiple players.
[*] Fixed controller not being able to view trinket info in the all trinket screen.
[*] Controller now has to hold Trinket Squad Screen and Character Info buttons to keep viewing them (like how it works on keyboard).
[*] Fixed grenade launcher length on controller (base and trinkets) not being able to reach max distance.
[*] Fixed controller menu navigation where it broke with character info screen and pause screen. 
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed problem where sometimes a player disconnecting desyncs your trinkets and squad trinkets.
[*] Crabs and Bone Sharks will not get confused if there's no raft left to target.
[*] Fixed clients not having to pay for some coin services in runs.
[*] Some particles now have maximum counts that can be spawned at a time (raft destruction, build poofs, raft icon effects, death poofs, bullet impacts, and rock shards).
[*] Players can not get hurt during cutscenes.
[*] Can no longer interact or buy items while paused.
[*] All trinket unlock screen now goes through list backwards, and sorts the ones not unlocked on the bottom.
[*] Player max magnet effect for in between biomes also procs for boss intros (so 5-3 money isn't lost when going to Super Kraken).
[*] Chests from Sailor ships and leaving the Ship of Dreams should now always reach an available raft.
[*] Fixed Boom Bloom explosions not damaging enemies.
[*] Fixed players emoting while paused.
[*] Fixed random bosses and stats manager waves_per_loop to allign with new biome progression.
[*] Helveti starts with 6 rafts instead of 5 (she could always hold 6 but started with 5 instead).
[*] Biome popup name should be the correct translation for clients, not be taken by the host's language.
[*] BFF Ring trinket description grammar fixed.
[*] Enemies loop health multiplier was higher than it was supposed to be, now it's back to normal (33% per loop for enemies, 225% per loop for bosses)
[*] Self inflicted explosion damage from grenade launcher and rockets is 1/4 heart instead of 1/2 heart.
[*] Other small improvements/fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each loop is now 5 biomes instead of 6.
[*] 0.25 seconds of i-frames are granted when landing from being hit by a geyser.
[*] Kraken bite hitbox time reduced (.75 -> .6).
[*] Base trinket drop chance and effect from Ship in a Bottle has been reduced.
[*] Enemy health per loop increased (33% -> 60%).
[*] Boss health per loop increased (225% -> 275%).
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.4 + Other News!
notes.content:
Hello rafters, we hope you enjoyed the latest major update! Things have slowed down a bit over here, but we have a couple things to say in addition to a new version and patch notes.

[h2]Ultimate Trinket Guide[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3138891288

There is now a trinket guide on Steam that gives more in depth info for all trinkets, and other useful info about them!

[h2]Kraken Slayer Testers[/h2]
In our Discord, we are opening up a special channel for everyone with the [i]Kraken Slayer[/i] role. This will give you access to a steam branch of the game with a separate save file that has debug tools to better test, find bugs, and push the game to it's limits with unlimited power. When using this version, you can only play with people also playing that version, so this is not for casual play. If you're interested, join the [url=https://shatteredjournalgames.com/discord]Discord[/url] and ask for the Kraken Slayer role (just screenshot the full Super Kraken statue to confirm you've beaten the game).

[h2]Turnip Boy Robs a Bank Launch[/h2]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=21fEZVVdhGo

Turnip Boy recently came to Super Raft Boat Together in our latest major update where you can go to Vegetable Stew, hire Turnip Boy, and fight against God Onion and his animal friends. First he committed tax evasion, now he's robbing a bank, and he has a lot more than just a sword and pistol this time. If you like the action and roguelike elements of SRBT, you'll love Turnip Boy Robs a Bank!

[h2]v1.3.4 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized player bullets.
[*] Fixed Kraken and God Onion lasers not dealing damage.
[*] Fixed God Onion nuclear balls not dealing damage.
[*] Fixed powder keg raft with barrel not having top part filled in.
[*] Fixed bug in later loops where strong Slugger bullets could cause enemies to have more health.
[*] Fixed Quantity Wood not changing time for Flimsy Rafts lasting based on how many stacks you have.
[*] Fixed Freeze and Shock bonus damage not working, even though the damage numbers showed it doing extra damage.
[*] Other small improvements/fixes.
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
[list]
[*] God Onion's fork attack is slightly slower in Phase 2 and 3.
[*] Added max trinket range for bullets (7 seconds + weapon's bullet time).
[*] Blood Bag, Macro Mush, and Romance Novel all appear 25% less.
[*] Venuz Blessing and Rear View Mirror appear 15% less.
[*] Epic and Cursed trinkets are more rare in Rare Chests.
[*] Rare trinkets are more rare in Common Chests.
[/list]

[h3]OTHER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players and helpers are no longer bounced by the Bumper Raft.
[*] Sailors will always go to the biome they want, unless you pay the compass bird otherwise.
[*] Max character experience that can be gained per run has been tripled.
[*] Added icons for modifier buttons (daily, weekly, tutorial).
[*] Attacks now have a max of 999,999 damage that can be dealt per attack.
[*] Damage dealt is now worth 90% less points for dailies/weeklies.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.3.1
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]

notes.title: v1.3.3
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Helveti won't lose breath while rolling over water anymore.
[*] Net Rafts regenerate breath faster for Helveti and Roboto.
[*] Powder Keg Raft will now become an empty raft that can be upgraded after the keg explodes.
[*] Metal Rafts are no longer destroyed instantly by God Onion's nuclear balls and soda bottle explosions.
[*] Before if the raft broke under you while in a chest, you'd be kicked out of the chest and given a random trinket. Now the chest will stay suspended in air until you pick.
[*] Rafts will not be destroyed by enemies during cutscenes.
[*] Hazards no longer need to be destroyed for a wave to continue.
[*] Shooting the Pirate Matey illusion now makes it vanish.
[*] Bone sharks will now swim in a random direction if there are no rafts left, and come back once there are rafts (same as crabs).
[/list]

[h2]UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Contact the developers!" button added on the newsboard.
[*] A yellow exclamation point shows up above hub shop keeps when they have something you can afford and don't own.
[*] Buy button in hub shops will be greyed out if you don't have enough to buy the item.
[*] Price is now visible of hub shop items on the buy screen, instead of just in the main shop screen.
[*] FPS and Ping Text moved to top right in gameplay, and below wind arrow in local multiplayer gameplay.
[*] Breath icon and sailor/barrel reminders will not display if UI Display is off.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed softlock if a player joins your group while using a locker.
[*] Fixed pause screen not showing up the first time you pause after leaving a group.
[*] Fixed rescue missions not showing as completed when you first do them.
[*] Fixed weapon equip sound playing when it shouldn't.
[*] Fixed modifier screen displaying the offline message before selecting a modifier.
[*] Fixed weekly screen message "only host can toggle" showing up when you've already done the weekly.
[*] Fixed Dolphin squads of 4 spawning too close too each other.
[*] Fixed Pirate Matey's illusions not reflecting the matey's position properly.
[*] Fixed menus re-opening when exiting by pressing the back button.
[*] Fixed local multiplayer controllers sharing emote wheel logic.
[*] Camera movement is now less sensitive on controller.
[*] Other small improvements/fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy Loop Health Multiplier Increased (25% -> 33%).
[*] Plastic Straw slow effect lasts longer at base and per stack.
[*] Ship of Dreams now has a chance to not appear after Super Kraken, except for the first loop where it always appears.
[*] During weeklies, Ship of Deals will have a lower chance to have Raft and Weapon swappers.
[*] During weeklies, Ship of Gear will have a lower chance to appear.
[*] Fishing Rafts drop rates have been altered to have rarer drops be rarer.
[*] Fishing Rafts can only spawn 1 egg, chest, and bottle per wave, and only 3 hearts per wave.
[*] Fishing Rafts will stop spawning drops once there are few enough enemies remaining and enough time has passed.
[*] Left and right side spawning enemies (Pirate Matey and Snail) have more varied spawning positions.
[*] Slowed down snails speed range, and snails are slower moving vertically towards the player while in water.
[*] Jellyfish are slightly faster.
[*] Soda fish movement and double jump logic changed.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.2 - Weeklies!
notes.content:
[h2]Weeklies[/h2]
We've had the daily, but now you can also play the weekly! You can replay it as many times as you want, but you're forced to use a specific build depending on the weekly seed, and your squad count.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added are you sure popups for quitting a run.
[*]Misfire Mantle will shoot a max of 30 bullets.
[*]Chrysalis growth per stack slightly reduced.
[*]Chrysalis bullets spawn slightly smaller.
[*]Made maxes for growth from Black Powder and Chrysalis.
[*]Fixed laser sniper hitbox expanding strangely with Chrysalis.
[*]Laser sniper hitbox goes away once the laser fully disappears.
[*]Haunted Lanterns fire rate buff reduced in base and stacking.
[*]Fishing Raft is now 2 cost (was 1).
[*]Computer Raft is now 1 cost (was 2).
[*]Buddy Banner now has a 30% damage buff (was 50%).
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with Dolphin rock hitbox persisting after it gets destroyed, resulting in players getting damaged from seemingly nothing.
[*]Fixed staying in pause screen making the game lag.
[*]Fixed Black Powder not affecting bullet hitboxes correctly.
[*]Fixed problem where you can get stuck behind the Egg merchant on Ship of Gear
[*]Fixed problems with popups.
[*]Fixed pirate mateys not bouncing off of metal rafts.
[*]Fixed pirate mateys and snails not reacting to bumper rafts.
[*]Fixed lightning not always breaking rafts.
[*]Local player drop icon stays full when dropping out in the hub by holding back.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.1
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ship of Gear will not spawn twice in a row.
[*] In single player gameplay, rafts and weapons won't spawn in shops if you already have them equipped.
[*] Fixed problems with player's ghost slow portals not working in online multiplayer.
[*] Fixed Rear View Mirror not working with grenade launcher.
[*] God Onion won't start moves before finishing them.
[*] Fixed ship leaving progress bar not showing up for Ship of Dreams.
[*] Made changes to make magnetism for pickups smoother in online multiplayer.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buddy Banner was epic rarity, is now rare.
[*] Rear View Mirror was rare rarity, is now epic.
[*] Backwards bullets are 20% slower, and deal 33% less damage.
[*] God Onion given slightly more health.
[*] Soaked Stopwatch does not effect the cooldown of using the slow portal as a ghost in multiplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.0 + Turnip Boy Crossover
notes.content:
Hello Super Raft Boat Together players! It's time for one more major update before 2024, and we got the fine folks at Snoozy Kazoo to help bring you new Turnip Boy content! Right now you can also get [i]Super Raft Boat Together[/i] and [i]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/i] in a bundle, AND they're both on sale right now for the Steam Winter Sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37340/Turnip_Boy_x_Super_Raft_Boat_Together_Crossover/

[h1]Vegetable Stew[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/de7ac9700d4364f370017ad5ff748e4cddc7ab67.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/c210b99c0dc38d708124db737c23ed180b10a8c8.gif[/img]

After Electric Flow, you would usually always go to Soda Sea, but now you could also go to Vegetable Stew! This new biome features enemies from [i]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/i], all swimming in a stew of veggies. Face off against God Onion, the corrupt mayor who gained ultimate power, and was once stopped by Turnip Boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/e4ce41b0e3369e3a07f23d902d10e906b19b1b35.gif[/img]

Turnip Boy himself is now a mercenary you can hire, and he has a higher chance to appear at the end of Vegetable Stew. There's a couple more surprises that are Turnip Boy related, so check out the update and see if you can find them all!

[h1]Fishing Raft[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/74814a597dc04fcfddf08fa13e00e355cc3485e2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/019f14f9e32dde676adb6722b3f9a5e3df49c8ae.gif[/img]

The fishing raft fishes up loot over time. More rafts improves chance of higher rarity loot. It can fish up money, hearts, trinkets, eggs, and more!

[h1]Ship of Gear[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/3b80643cf1531cb220f28a2d89c18016cae697dd.gif[/img]

There's a chance that instead of going to the Ship of Deals after finishing a biome, you'll instead go to the Ship of Gear! Here you can buy weapons and rafts for dollars, rather than paying with coins when they appear as passengers at the Ship of Deals. On the flipside, the merchants from Ship of Deals can appear on the new ship, but accept coins instead of dollars for trinkets. There's also a new merchant that sells eggs and can appear on both ships.

[h1]New Trinkets[/h1]

[h2]Boom Bloom[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/489ca5ecf225cd195f1088a6a89ed4f1b49ef0f9.png[/img]

Chance to attach a bomb to an enemy on hit.

[h2]Third Eye[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/2f9b2f50cb0ac2625afbc4ec824d7e71552b63db.png[/img]

Enemies outside your party's vision are slowed and randomly take damage.

[h2]Rear View Mirror[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/feb1c610fe337df9bf4deafc7983fc25ab5947e3.png[/img]

Shoot extra bullet behind you.

[h2]Buddy Banner[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/c5b6c8afb07e508d03a469714aafd970a1956e02.png[/img]

50% damage buff to all buddies.

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Biome: Vegetable Stew
[*] Boss: God Onion
[*] Mercenary: Turnip Boy
[*] Egg Animal: Cat Apple
[*] Super Raft: Fishing Raft
[*] Trinket: Boom Bloom
[*] Trinket: Third Eye
[*] Trinket: Rear View Mirror
[*] Trinket: Buddy Banner
[/list]
[h3]New Systems[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ship of Gear has a 30% chance to show up instead of Ship of Deals.
[*] Egg merchant added, he can appear at Ship of Deals and Gear.
[*] Raft art has been updated. Raft outlines only appear on the outside of the raft grid.
[*] After looping, non-unlocked trinkets will be added to the trinket pool for the rest of the run. More trinkets are added per loop.
[*] Starting at Loop 5, the cost added to shop items per loop goes up from 60% per loop to 100% per loop.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello Super Raft Boat Together players! It's time for another update! This one focuses more on quality of life, base improvements to the game, and points brought up by the community!

[h1]Boss Squads[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/aaa759772e890b3c97a13b946eba1dc1dcd612fa.gif[/img]

On Loop 1 some bosses (Dolphin, Otter, and Giant Fish) will appear as a duo. On Loop 2 they'll become a trio, and on Loop 3 and beyond, they'll become a squad of 4. Dolphin, Otter, and Cooler also got buffs to make them tougher.

[h1]Lobby Ghosts[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/294ef3e7cbe5e9e4a2924cb48a25ffa26e14d7fa.gif[/img]

There's a new way to find people to raft boat together! Lobby Ghosts will now appear in Raftport. They represent players that are hosting public lobbies or queuing. You can see who they're playing and how many are in their party. The public lobby list has also been updated to show this information.

[h1]Beta Power Slide[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/99a23cb9bcf6bba99735377ad2466f5a3f85da08.gif[/img]

Beta can now "Power Slide" when starting a slide on a Buddy Raft. The power slide is more powerful and has more knockback, and instantly recharges his active ability. Beta can also cancel out of it with a regular slide. Beta will not hi-five Buddy Rafts when power sliding, only regular slide.

[h1]Magnet Raft[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/1eb632cf16c4f08623f6447ec2b8676e7b67c5bf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/815bb799c8cff667c974c0002db5da717671c930.gif[/img]

The magnet raft will draw in money, pickups, chests, bottles, and helpers that have fallen in the water. They're pretty handy to retain money from enemies, and can be used to make saves for drowning helpers!

[h1]New Trinkets[/h1]

[h2]Haunted Lantern[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/2c9e505a859f10ab87124d1688f14fc749fcd774.png[/img]

Increases fire rate of self and allies when closeby to them, but your view becomes more limited.

[h2]Chrysalis[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/72a220e935532641accbe66ea9119660a07e22a2.png[/img]

Reduced bullet size, but bullet size increases over time. Damage now scales with bullet size.

[h2]Dead Man's Switch[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/121780559733ec07743827e52a7ce53cb45f4157.png[/img]

When an ally or buddy dies, burst into bullets. (Only in multiplayer)

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Super Raft: Magnet Raft
[*] New Trinket: Dead Man's Switch
[*] New Trinket: Chrysalis
[*] New Trinket: Haunted Lantern
[/list]
[h3]New Systems[/h3]
[list]
[*] Join a game by interacting with a Lobby Ghost. If you queue or host a public lobby, your player's ghost will appear in other player's lobbies, and they can join you.
[*] Beta can now "Power Slide" when starting a slide on a Buddy Raft. The power slide is more powerful and has more knockback, and instantly recharges his active ability. Beta can also cancel out of it with a regular slide. Beta will not hi-five Buddy Rafts when power sliding, only regular slide.
[*] Dolphin, Otter, and Giant Fish variants will show up in squads of 2, 3, and 4 after looping.
[*] Breathing UI above player has been revamped to be more clear. Healing Raft progress will also display in the same way.
[*] Player effect icons show up on the bottom of the screen to show what effects are active. These include super raft, trinkets, and status effects (only for non local-multiplayer).
[*] Ship of Deals now sells stacks of raft wood instead of eggs.
[*] Ship of Deals traveler spots are now merged. Raft Swapper, Weapons Dealer, Compass Bird, and Mercenaries can now appear at either spot on the ship.
[*] Added options menu to title screen.
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pickups now fade much faster and will flash 5 seconds before fading instead of a timer above them.
[*] Chauncy now takes damage from sharks during his active ability.
[*] Beta's regular slide has decreased power and knockback.
[*] Mystery Wood is now a cursed trinket, and has an increased chance per stack.
[*] Ship in a Bottle is now 50% more rare compared to other epic trinkets.
[*] Snoozy Credit Card and Steamy Deal are 20% more rare.
[*] Mercs coin cost raised (5 -> 8)
[*] All mini-bosses and swarms now always give 5 coins.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spiky Rafts no longer hurt players and helpers.
[*] Ship of Dreams will now restore half of the player's max rafts.
[*] When the tutorial forces you to take damage from drowning, you're also teleported back to the raft.
[*] Reset save data option is now only in the title screen options menu.
[*] Added option to toggle Lobby Ghosts on/off.
[*] On rare spawn chances, rocks could be money or gold rocks that drop extra dollars or coins.
[*] Knockback for enemies has been reworked.
[*] Dolphin dash gets interrupted by Bumper Raft.
[*] Dolphin will move in phase 2 and 3 while showing their warning.
[*] Otter shoots more seashells in succession instead of one burst per roar.
[*] Cooler shoots more soda bottles at a time after each phase.
[*] After looping, Cooler will also throw slower big blue soda bottles that destroy rafts.
[*] Soda bottles thrown by Cooler have warnings.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Controllers can now properly view trinket menus in game and at Ron's Fishing Stand.
[*] Ship of Deals will have less duplicate trinkets for sale.
[*] Mercenaries and compass choices can't be bought without having enough.
[*] Keybindings can now be assigned to keys even if they're already binded to something.
[*] Laser now gets bigger from Portal Rafts like other bullets.
[*] Macro Mush now gives 1.5 health when picked up instead of only 1.
[*] Fixed soda bottles not exploding when hitting rafts.
[*] Jellyfish back to only shocking when nearby a player or helper.
[*] Sailors that spawn during Path to Kraken should now always be rescuable before the point where you can't loop.
[*] Cooler and Dolphin won't shoot at dead players.
[*] Boss health bar for swarms is smoother.
[*] When a client buys a random bottle it will show the trinket they recieved for a bit (was only doing it for hosts)
[*] When a client buys an item, a poof of clouds will appear (was only doing it for hosts)
[*] Raft Swapper and Weapons Dealers animation speeds are now consistent with other characters.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0 - Soda Sea, Raft Swapping, Missions, and More!
notes.content:
Hello Super Raft Boat Together players! It's been a while since there's been an update. We've been preparing this for a while now so there's tons of new stuff, let's take a look!


[h1]New Biome: Soda Sea[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/5bf9eed111273a476a55a9b2892ef7d5800a1354.gif[/img]

After Electric Flow, fend off enemies of sea and sky that have been influenced by Soda! The enemies are tough, and the boss Cooler is even tougher!

[list]
[*] Soda Fish has an extra jump using a soda bottle burst to propel upwards.
[*] Bluejay will shoot a six pack of soda bottle missiles towards you, and wanders while recharging soda.
[*] Soda Shark will charge up a dash to chomp through multiple rafts, make sure to take them out!
[*] Soda bottles will hurt rafts and players if they collide.
[*] Soda geysers will destroy rafts and knock players into the air!
[/list]

[h1]Super Raft Swapper[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/5b487414e03d56efb9c6858908a6adeba426ce0d.gif[/img]

The "Super Raft Swapper" can now appear at the Ship of Deals! Swap out your raft for the run and try a new raft! There are 12 super rafts to use total: 4 from the character's super rafts, 4 that will show up in the shop, and 4 you can unlock to show up at the shop.

[h1]New Super Rafts[/h1]

Here are the 4 super rafts that will show up by default, try to unlock the other 4!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/2a62d3325ddcb26ea519d109b9916e093209a5a2.png[/img]
[h3]Construction Raft[/h3]
Faster build rate when standing on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/99044abf57ee54f0309aa2c0d10e9a79aee19a90.png[/img]
[h3]Marksman Raft[/h3]
Increased fire rate and critical chance while standing on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/b17f88ee3ea533b89ee6e6b3eeebb215fb8bcc71.png[/img]
[h3]Powder Keg Raft[/h3]
Explodes after an amount of time after being placed or when destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/843df47b83acea43350f198da8be707b3c4d66bc.png[/img]
[h3]Bumper Raft[/h3]
Bounces entities that touch it.

[h1]Weapons Dealer[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/0c1aaf782d51beb76bfa90d2d5824d3151496984.gif[/img]

In addition to the Super Raft Swapper, there's also a Weapons Dealer where you can swap to different weapons for the right amount of coins.

[h1]Raftport, Rescues, and Missions[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/50479041cc4f3eb4ff8cc22af62c05deb39ca36e.gif[/img]

Raftport has been polished up and condensed, and Ron got a fishing stand for his rods! Also, where did everybody go? During runs you'll have to find and rescue them and regain their services!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/cd1353fc34a75a67e5ad73160d1d65d4ef41bbfd.gif[/img]

There are now missions to track progression like rescues and Kraken defeats, and daily missions that refresh every day. Missions can give coins and bottles, and tougher ones will unlock new content like areas and super rafts. Some missions will also show up after finishing others, what else could there be to unlock?

[h1]Path to Kraken[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/c71721f6a200efb588870141376a6c73803c259e.png[/img]

Each time you defeat the Kraken Swarm, you'll gain a new tentacle added to the Kraken Statue in Raftport. When the statue gets four tentacles added, you'll be able to face off against the Super Kraken! 
Each Kraken victory will change up the next run and slightly vary them up. Defeating the Super Kraken unlocks looping and more variance to runs. Can you finish the Kraken Statue?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/f2359fb31bf2d0e6931e7d8213cd9c2191b796c1.gif[/img]

[h1]Keybindings[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546955/8b7d32a2e052a41beb0d9c1233b2159c4faf25e5.gif[/img]

Keybindings have been a top request and something we wanted in since launch, so it's nice to finally have it implemented!

[h1]The Rest of the Update[/h1]

There's a lot of big stuff in this update, but also a lot of smaller things. Here's the full patch notes of everything not talked about above.

[h2]Other New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Boss: Otter
[*] New Boss: Cooler
[*] New Boss: Giant Jellyfish
[*] New Boss: Giant Bone Fish
[*] New Trinket: Quickdraw Cola
[*] New Trinket: Misfire Mantle
[*] Reenabled Trinket: Soggy Toolbox
[/list]
[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Raft refill rate is faster with less players.
[*] Squad trinkets now scale to be less powerful with a larger squad.
[*] Macro Mush health buff is now 1 heart.
[*] Smelly Sea Pickle decription fixed (takes half a heart away, but it said it took 1 heart).
[*] Orange Soda will now heal 4 hearts instead of full.
[*] Quantity Wood now also makes super rafts cost an extra raft.
[*] Glass Hat no longer works as a ghost.
[*] Seagulls are slower and glide for longer and further after a drill attack.
[*] Fish are slightly slower.
[*] Trout are slower but have more health.
[*] Wahoo Fish are faster but have less health.
[*] Crabs are twice as fast at destroying rafts.
[*] Dolphin won't dash on the first "Path to Kraken" run.
[*] Pufferfish spike bullets do quarter heart damage (big spikes from Giant Pufferfish still do half heart)
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Super rafts now have different raft costs.
[*] Coins collected from runs can no longer be used in runs. Coins remaining from runs are taken back to be used at Raftport.
[*] Last enemy in swarm drops coins now.
[*] Trinket bottles can now be picked up in water.
[*] Wave and Shop events have higher chance of happening each time they don't happen.
[*] Improved mini-boss randomization.
[*] Tutorial will now end after the first boss and the tour has been updated.
[*] New Option: Toggle Status Effect Particles
[*] Beta's super raft the Buddy Raft now also speeds up players on it.
[*] Beta's hi-five with his Buddy Raft will also hi-five closeby Buddy Rafts (he can only hi-five penguins not already being hi-fived)
[*] Money is now shown in the trinket squad screen for the crew.
[*] Optimized status effects.
[*] Other small improvements/fixes.
[/list]
